title: Order update
description: One order status change from Hyperliquid's `orderUpdates` stream as the adapter publishes it (src/venues/hyperliquid/user.ts, OrderUpdate). Money is canonical decimal strings; ids are the venue's exact digits. `lifecycle` is the status registry's reading of `status` (0003 §2.13); `unknown` pages.

cloid.description: 0x + 32 hex lower-cased; any other id verbatim.

orderType.description: An open-orders row's or an orderStatus reply's type name, as the venue wrote it ("Limit", "Stop Market", "Take Profit Limit"…); the stream's frames carry none (0004 amendment 3 d3, d7).

tif.description: Its time in force ("Gtc", "Alo", "Ioc"); absent on a trigger and on a stream frame.

isTrigger.description: A trigger order that has not triggered; absent otherwise.

triggerPx.description: A trigger's price; only with isTrigger.

isPositionTpsl.description: A take-profit or stop-loss of the whole position; absent otherwise.

children.description: The venue ids of the orders grouped under this one; absent when none.

canonical.description: A canonical decimal string: no trailing zeros, no exponent. Never a JSON number.
